Definition: from πίων (fat; perhaps akin to the alternate of G4095 through the idea of repletion); plumpness, i.e. (by implication) richness (oiliness):--fatness.
BiblicalUsage: Piotes is fatness, the richness of the olive tree. Paul uses it once, in Romans 11:17: wild branches grafted in partake of the root and fatness of the olive tree.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Gentiles like me were grafted into a richness we never grew ourselves.
